title: The Hormone That Talks Your Brain Out of Hunger
subject: GLP-1 / GIP dual agonists (tirzepatide, Zepbound) — mechanism of appetite suppression and weight loss
production_route: hybrid — animation rendered locally (deterministic canvas renderer in Chromium + ffmpeg), narration generated on Higgsfield, final mux server-side via explainer_video

voice.name: Cillian
voice.note: same narrator as Episode 1, for channel continuity

subtitles.source: whisper transcription of the voiceover, burned in at assembly

clip_delivery: clips served to Higgsfield via jsDelivr over the public repo (cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/...) because this container's egress policy blocks both the Higgsfield CDN and its S3 upload host
